scope: Reusable offline image-bound Hyper3D request preparation, native topology verification and same-source comparison planning.

reference.rgba_hash_basis: big-endian uint32 width,height followed by decoded RGBA bytes

comparison_targets.comparison_type: same-source-image; normalization and render settings must be aligned before geometric/color ranking
same-source-image; normalization and render settings must be aligned before geometric/color ranking

reusable_changes: Offline prepare/dry-run validates reviewed existing references, file hashes, source version, pose and live review ledger.
Unsupported static WebP is re-encoded as equal-size, pixel-identical RGBA PNG; encoded and pixel hashes are recorded.
Request is idempotently stored in ignored private output; changed request or metadata requires a separate job version.
OBJ/GLB inspector now reports source_face_vertex_histogram and quad_face_fraction without changing native geometry.
Skill source, installed copy, README and generation-tool routing include the Hyper3D workflow.
limitations: No Hyper3D inference or output inspection has been performed; quality improvements are hypotheses for the prepared trial.
Current plan has one real reference; verified same-pose genuine multi-angle sources are not yet available.
Ark accepts 1-5 image inputs but does not expose calibrated camera/MultiView semantics.
Native quad topology and returned PBR/texture bundle must be inspected; GLB and trimesh-derived OBJ are triangulated.
TAPose is static pose conditioning, without a rig, skinning or animation guarantee.
The offline budget fields do not implement submission reservations or account-level enforcement; ark-task.py remains a separate explicit submit operation.
Existing reference, generated-media rights and local-only distribution restrictions still apply.
